name: Pod shell (foam-board box, XPS LE filler and nose block, printed nose lip and antenna tube)
process: knife/laser-cut foam board, hot-wire XPS, FDM lip and tube
notes: floor, 2 side walls (16 x 12 mm power/DShot exits, CR-F2-03), nose wall (pitot, vent and antenna holes), aft wall (vent + servo-lead exits), aft deck; 7 mm XPS nose block bonded to the nose and side walls; 6 mm microballoon fillets floor-to-wall at the straps (CR-C6-17); light tape on the top (CR-E3-03) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Tray: bay floor (2 pieces) + 3 mm forward stop + 1.5 mm guides, FC, avionics, PDB and UBEC plates, JR tie bar (printed PETG)
process: FDM PETG, 7 prints epoxied full-area to the floor
notes: 4 strap slots 37 x 1.8 mm; 10 mm wire channel across the bay at x -0.0655 (CR-F2-03); FC on 4 gel cubes between end stops with strap slots (CR-F3-12, CR-C6-19); airspeed between tie posts 21 mm apart, foam tape + 1 tie; 4 M3 heat-set inserts for F1 power frame (25 mm pattern); UBEC plate x 0.044-0.072 (CR-F1-17); JR tie bar x 0.021-0.040 right channel (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Hatch (foam board, printed tongue, 12 x 40 hook-and-loop tab, antenna tube A)
process: knife-cut foam board, FDM tongue and tube
notes: tool-free, no magnets: tongue under the nose lip, hook-and-loop tab on the aft deck; receiver antenna A up the tube (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Pack straps (2, 20 mm hook-and-loop, rubber-backed) + 2 EVA pads 2.5 mm
vendor_or_file: battery strap 20 x 300 mm (any RC vendor); EVA sheet 2.5 mm with anti-slip face
notes: two straps at the pack quarter points, overlap >= 50 mm marked; slots let them follow the station range (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: GPS mast with 45 deg pad (printed PETG, plugs into the handle grip)
notes: GPS taped on the pad tilted 45 deg toward the nose, arrow forward; GPS cable up the mast bore; PA66 M3 screw + nut (no steel within 50 mm, CR-C6-18) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Pitot boom socket with 32 mm flange (printed PETG, pod nose, left channel)
notes: bore 6.2 mm for the 6 mm keyed boom (F3 accepted); flange bonded to the nose wall inside face (CR-C6-09) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Carry handle on the spar with the aft stop bridge (printed PETG) + 'LIFT HERE - do not lift by the motors' label
process: FDM PETG, printed lying flat, 40 % infill feet and grip
notes: feet saddle the spar top in the open slot, one 7.6 mm nylon tie each round foot + spar; bridge between the feet carries the 3 mm aft stop and 2 gussets; legs through the aft deck; GPS cable in the right leg (window at z 0.055-0.065) and a groove under the grip (CR-F2-03) (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)

name: Trim kit: XPS crush block (cut per pack), 1.5 mm PETG spreader, PETG U-spacers 2 / 4 / 8 / 8 mm
notes: block ahead of the pack (CR-C5-02), spacers behind it; CAD and mass: nominal 550 g pack = block 27.7 mm + spreader + 8 mm spacer; 2 / 4 / 8 mm spare spacers in the field kit (mass EST from CAD; cost EST: board, filament, straps, ties, inserts)
